body:
New task file: research/TASK_C19.md. Model top tier, effort medium, Fast off. Read it and only the files it names.

One new read-only function on GameState: get_booking_board(athlete_id) returning the offer board ALREADY GRADED - a verdict, a one-line diagnosis, up to four reason chips each with a tone and a named source, the gate estimate and what one gate point is worth. R33 (Claude, starting now) reads it once per rebuild and computes nothing itself, exactly as ProfileRevampPanel reads your get_fighter_card().

Every reason must come from something that already exists - fame gate, rating gap, division rankings, rivalry band, short notice cause and premium, camp length, clause obligation, title stakes, money against the tier norm. Invent no model. Weight class and sex are RULES, not reasons: never surface them as advice, assert them in the test.

TWO HAZARDS, both named in the task file. get_fight_offers() advances weekly tick markers (GameState.gd:10619) and your function must be idempotent - two calls in one career week return identical data and leave the save unchanged; if you cannot avoid the tick advance, SAY SO rather than silently working around it, and do not change get_fight_offers()'s own behaviour. And GameState.gd is ~8k lines: never read it whole, the anchors in the task file are the only slices you need.

Owned files are GameState.gd (one function plus helpers, nothing else in the file) and a new tests/booking_board_api_test.gd. Parse gate then the test, then fight_contract_test, booking_eligibility_visibility_test, weight_class_matchmaking_test, sex_matchmaking_test, then the full suite. Research-adjacent but this one IS code: no HANDOFF block, I write yours. Push your own deliverables.
topic: C19 assigned: the booking read API
